assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, heritage zones, road redlines, parcels, utilities, fire constraints, surveyed buildings, access control, real vertical assets and measured step-free routes are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Spatial and construction content remains conceptual; no statutory, ownership, demolition or engineering conclusion may be made.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are rough repository geometry inferred from public descriptions and approximate areas. Reproducible community checks in repository Issue #1029 report that provisional PROV-KEY-003 is internally area/order-consistent but centred near Beijing North Station, about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi metro; this is not an official replacement boundary or permission to shift it.
assumptions.impact: The package keeps upstream geometry only as a placeholder and treats Dazhongsi as the programme name from the brief, not a verified map anchor. All real sites require separate verification; canonical or official geometry must trigger whole-package recalculation.

assumptions.statement: No current lift/platform-lift asset, state, service hour, alarm, route dependency, inspection result or Dazhongsi partner is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Every current asset and state requires authorised registers and field verification before public use.

assumptions.statement: No using unit, owner, site operator, licensed maintainer, inspection/testing organisation, accessibility co-test group or alternative-service operator is assumed to have committed.
assumptions.impact: A real pilot cannot start until roles, windows, escalation, stop/reuse and alternative duties are written.

assumptions.statement: Public reports, sensors and AI do not replace the using unit, licensed maintenance, qualified inspection/testing, fire/emergency command or other legally competent roles.
assumptions.impact: The service can trigger verification and publish authorised state only; it cannot certify safety or authorise reuse.

assumptions.statement: AI never controls a lift, bypasses protection, decides stop/reuse, performs maintenance, declares inspection results or issues emergency evacuation commands.
assumptions.impact: AI is limited to conflict detection, clustering, summarisation and decision support with human authority.

assumptions.statement: The minimum schema has no identity, health, face, voice, exact personal route, employer or continuous-trajectory field.
assumptions.impact: Discovery of a sensitive field is a stop condition; public reporting works without registration.

assumptions.statement: The protocol bench, co-testing classroom, service station and simulated fault node are study types, not confirmed sites or assets.
assumptions.impact: Survey, consent, structure, MEP, fire, accessibility, operations and special-equipment review precede siting.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day phases and 5/10-minute service SLOs are proposed for joint confirmation, not legal limits or current performance.
assumptions.impact: The pilot may shrink, pause or stop when responsibility, safety, data, labour or accessibility gates fail.

assumptions.statement: Early drills use synthetic fault events and authorised route walk-throughs and never disable a real in-service lift.
assumptions.impact: Failure, handover and audit can be tested without connecting to safety controls or disrupting service.

assumptions.statement: Public state is limited to UNKNOWN, READY, DEGRADED and CLOSED; stale evidence automatically becomes UNKNOWN.
assumptions.impact: Repair records without qualified human recommissioning cannot restore READY.

assumptions.statement: No new lift/platform-lift, shaft, structure, fire, MEP, product, cost or construction solution is approved by this concept.
assumptions.impact: Any addition requires a separate professional feasibility, statutory review, procurement and lifecycle-maintenance process.
